elements.commandsql:
SELECT q.id AS id, c.id AS courseid, c.fullname AS course, cm.id AS cmid,
 q.id AS quizid, q.name AS quiz_name,
 COALESCE(sl.questions,0) AS question_slots, COALESCE(st.learners_attempted,0) AS learners_attempted,
 COALESCE(st.attempts,0) AS attempts, COALESCE(st.finished_attempts,0) AS finished_attempts,
 st.completion_rate_percent, st.average_score_percent, st.minimum_score_percent,
 st.maximum_score_percent, st.standard_deviation_percent, st.average_duration, st.pass_rate_percent
FROM mdl_quiz q
 JOIN mdl_course c ON c.id=q.course
 JOIN mdl_modules m ON m.name='quiz'
 JOIN mdl_course_modules cm ON cm.course=q.course AND cm.module=m.id AND cm.instance=q.id
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT quizid,COUNT(*) AS questions FROM mdl_quiz_slots GROUP BY quizid) sl ON sl.quizid=q.id
 LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT qa.quiz, COUNT(*) AS attempts, COUNT(DISTINCT qa.userid) AS learners_attempted,
 SUM(CASE WHEN qa.state='finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished_attempts,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN qa.state='finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS completion_rate_percent,
 ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN qa.state='finished' AND q2.sumgrades>0 THEN 100.0*qa.sumgrades/q2.sumgrades END),2) AS average_score_percent,
 ROUND(MIN(CASE WHEN qa.state='finished' AND q2.sumgrades>0 THEN 100.0*qa.sumgrades/q2.sumgrades END),2) AS minimum_score_percent,
 ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN qa.state='finished' AND q2.sumgrades>0 THEN 100.0*qa.sumgrades/q2.sumgrades END),2) AS maximum_score_percent,
 ROUND(STDDEV_POP(CASE WHEN qa.state='finished' AND q2.sumgrades>0 THEN 100.0*qa.sumgrades/q2.sumgrades END),2) AS standard_deviation_percent,
 ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN qa.state='finished' AND qa.timefinish>qa.timestart THEN qa.timefinish-qa.timestart END),0) AS average_duration,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN qa.state='finished' AND gi.gradepass>0 AND q2.sumgrades>0 AND q2.grade>0
 AND qa.sumgrades*q2.grade/q2.sumgrades>=gi.gradepass THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/
 NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN qa.state='finished' AND gi.gradepass>0 AND q2.sumgrades>0 AND q2.grade>0 AND qa.sumgrades IS NOT NULL
 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),2) AS pass_rate_percent
 FROM mdl_quiz_attempts qa JOIN mdl_quiz q2 ON q2.id=qa.quiz
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT courseid,iteminstance,MAX(gradepass) AS gradepass FROM mdl_grade_items
 WHERE itemtype='mod' AND itemmodule='quiz' GROUP BY courseid,iteminstance) gi
 ON gi.courseid=q2.course AND gi.iteminstance=q2.id
 WHERE qa.preview=0 GROUP BY qa.quiz
 ) st ON st.quiz=q.id
WHERE c.visible=1 AND cm.visible=1 ORDER BY c.fullname,q.name
